messages:
Maya (Docs): Quick sync: translators reported inconsistent Spanish copy for our residency section (APAC/SEA/LATAM). Need microcopy review + snippet check.
Chris (SDK): I can review snippets. Which headers should we surface in examples? We have three in-flight: Prefer-Region, X-Redwood-Region, Accept-Region (legacy).
Tess (Platform): For most customers we recommend Prefer-Region (routing preference). Use X-Redwood-Region when you need strict pinning to a region/hardware.
Maya (Docs): Good. For Spanish we should translate "residency controls" as "controles de residencia" (avoid "enforcement" words). Please avoid literal "region enforcement" in translations.
Ravi (Legal): Confirmed: "controles de residencia" OK. Also replace any absolute claims like "data never leaves" with "datos se rigen según los controles de residencia" and include link to policy.
LinkBot: link-checker: /docs/onprem/residency -> 404. Suggested redirect -> /docs/private/residency-guides.
Chris (SDK): I'll add a minimal curl + Node example showing header precedence and a one-line CLI migration. Curl sample:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Prefer-Region: apac-sg" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: apac-sg" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Maya (Docs): Nice and compact. Add a two-row table under examples: header name | purpose | ordering (Prefer-Region | routing preference | 1st) etc. Keep table text short so translations fit.
Tess (Platform): Note for Private deployments: routing is subject to customer network config and on-prem residency settings. Add a parenthetical about KMS/HSM for enterprise.
Ravi (Legal): Add a footnote: "Enterprise customers can configure key storage (KMS/HSM) per residency policy." Approve microcopy change.
Chris (SDK): CLI migration line added: `redwoodctl deploy --residency=apac-sg` (replaces `--region` flag). Also added Accept-Region in a short legacy note.
Maya (Docs): LinkBot flagged an internal anchor mismatch: anchor #on-prem in the Private doc moved to #private-deployments. Please update cross-link.
LinkBot: anchor-check: broken -> /docs/private/residency-guides#on-prem. Suggested -> /docs/private/residency-guides#private-deployments.
Chris (SDK): Fixed links in PR. Also included sanitized staging logs showing latency to apac staging ~55ms.
Tess (Platform): I ran a quick canary and observed routing respects Prefer-Region but when X-Redwood-Region set it pins to the region (expected).
Maya (Docs): Timeline: Chris to push link/anchor fixes and compact headers table in PR today, Ravi sign-off on legal phrasing, Tess integration smoke test tomorrow, then I merge and trigger translations.
Ravi (Legal): Approved once links fixed. Gracias :+1:.
Maya (Docs): Thanks all. I'll add a short translator note to the PR explaining the preferred Spanish terms and to avoid absolute language.
